# Keys you hand over - qa-case-designer

## Outputs

- `work/test-cases/` - cases are the designer's

Required at your stop (stage S4): `work/test-cases/`.
The gate also reads:
- a case file whose id is its file name: `= the file name`

## Witness

Your witness artifact (stages.json `witness`): `work/test-cases/`.

## Handoff form

Contract `s4-designer-to-case-critic` (fill `work/handoffs/<dispatch>.yaml`; `handoff_check.py` reads it):

- `inputs_read[].version` (required) - plan_revision
- `inputs_read[].rows` (required) - how many rows carried a case-bearing disposition
- `header.window` (required) - the case ids of this dispatch
- `header.verdict` (required) - one of vocabulary.header_verdicts
- `scope[].id` (required) - case id
- `scope[].state` (required) - one of vocabulary.row_states
- `scope[].reason` (required) - a verdict of at most 80 characters - the explanation lives in the artifact
- `scope[].plan_row` (required) - P-n
- `scope[].obligations` (required) - the obligation ids of that row, quoted unchanged
- `scope[].requirements` (required) - the R-ids the case proves
- `scope[].case_version` (required) - the pinned cv_ id of the bytes handed over
- `scope[].origin` (required) - new|extended|reused
- `scope[].reuse_of` (optional) - the existing case this extends or replaces, or a dash
- `scope[].disposition` (required) - automate|manual-agent|manual-human
- `scope[].design_review_required` (required) - true|false
- `scope[].self_probe` (optional) - what the designer checked itself - the seeded defect, the bounded negative, the fixture substitution - or a dash with why not
- `review_scope.cases` (required) - the case ids whose validated design_review_required is true
- `review_scope.rounds_used` (required) - how many repair rounds these cases have already had, of the two allowed
- `review_scope.focus[]` (required) - what the designer knows is weak here, in one line - the honest pointer that saves a round
- `artifacts.cases_root` (required) - the store the cases really live in - config.cases_root or work/test-cases
- `artifacts.appendix` (optional) - work/case-appendix.md, when it has been rendered
- `claims.every_case_bearing_plan_row_has_at_least_one_case` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_case_quotes_its_rows_obligation_ids` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_case_in_scope_is_pinned_and_the_version_is_named` (required) - true|false
- `claims.every_case_names_the_requirement_it_proves_not_a_test` (required) - true|false
- `claims.existing_cases_were_checked_before_new_ones_were_written` (required) - true|false
- `tried[].requirement` (required) - R-n, a source id or an area
- `tried[].technique` (required) - the technique by its name in your charter
- `tried[].observation` (required) - what you saw, in one line
- `tried[].evidence` (required) - the path (and anchor) where it shows
- `tried_note` (optional) - why the table is empty, or a dash when it has rows
- `unresolved[].id` (required) - case id or P-n
- `unresolved[].reason` (required) - one of vocabulary.unresolved_reasons
- `unresolved[].detail` (required) - what exactly is missing, and what would settle it
- `blocked.field` (only when blocked) - the field of this file the role cannot fill
- `blocked.problem` (only when blocked) - what the role tried and what refused it, verbatim
- `blocked.tried[]` (only when blocked) - command or step, and its answer
- `blocked.data[]` (only when blocked) - path of anything the conductor needs to see

Every handoff form shares one skeleton (`common_shape` of handoffs/index.yaml): `inputs`, `inputs_read`, `header`, `scope`, `artifacts`, `claims`, `unresolved`, `blocked`.
